Blizzard Is Breaking the Layer Swap Addon in WoW Forever
catalog.description:
Blizzard is breaking the Layer Swap addon with an upcoming hotfix in WoW Forever. You can still hop layers after that hotfix, but you can't pick which one. Layer Swap used to list the layers and send you to the one you wanted.

Blizzard's addon notes (WoWUIDev Discord, copied word for word by Wowhead and on the WoW forums, Nov 20): "The realm ID in creature, vehicle, pet and game object GUIDs is now obfuscated along with the server ID and spawn ID. This will also apply to Forever in an upcoming 1.60.1 hotfix."
Layer Swap reads which layer you are on from the creatures around you. With that hidden, no addon can tell one layer from another, so you can no longer pick the layer you hop to.
You can still change layers: the addon author's Novembe
